Grand New Opening on the 12 November 2019, Hanoi Lotus Boutique Hotel is a new renovated hotel located in the heart of Hanoi`s historic Old Quarter. The Hanoi Lotus Boutique Hotel is a 4 star hotel that offers elegant rooms, including views of the city and large balconies. We pride ourselves on offering the best service to our customers. Ideally located in the heart of Hanoi`s ancient streets, the hotel is just 5 minutes walk to the famous Hoan Kiem Lake (Lake of the Restored Sword) , Thang Long Water Puppet Theater and all shopping and banking facilities. The dining, entertainment and central business districts are also conveniently located, just a few minutes walk away from our hotel. Hanoi Lotus Boutique hotel was designed and constructed to high architectural standards. It is among the Hanoi Old Quarter`s top ten, luxurious hotels and has an excellent view of Hanoi. The Hanoi Lotus Boutique hotel provides you with comfortable and relaxing accommodation, in well-appointed rooms, furnished with the latest facilities. Our hotel is serviced by an elevator and all 35 spacious rooms have timber floors, wooden furniture in modern and luxurious style, IDD telephones, LG 32" HD LCD TV, DVD player, modern air-conditioning, mini-bar, well-appointed bathroom , hair dryer, your own private computer with free, high-speed internet access and Wifi. In addition, all rooms have tea and coffee-making facilities, safety deposit box and 10 special rooms have city views and large balconies. All rooms include Buffet breakfast with complimentary, tea and coffee all day for guests staying in the hotel. Hanoi Lotus Boutique Hotel`s friendly staff will be glad to advise you on local places of interest and assist with any tours or travel arrangements you may require. Hanoi Lotus Boutique Hotel is a great choice for all discerning tourists & business travelers. When you come to our hotel you will be very satisfied with our outstanding service and the hospitality provided by our team of professional staff and management. Happy Travels !
